_comment: `expected_sources`: substrings matched against a hit's document name, id or text —
supplying them unlocks hit-rate, recall@k, MRR and nDCG.
`expected_answer_terms`: facts the answer should contain — scores answer correctness.
Run with:  python -m rag_assistant.cli benchmark --suite eval/questions.example.json --label before

questions.question: Which vector database does this project use by default?
How are deleted documents removed from the index?
What is the capital of an entirely unrelated fictional country?
